headline: Coinbase Global (COIN) Wins SEC Backing For Binaries And Flags Bitcoin Quantum Risk
summary: Coinbase Global (NasdaqGS:COIN) is working with Evernorth as it shifts to active management of a sizeable XRP treasury in 2026. headline: Mastercard Puts $1.8 Billion BVNK Deal to Work With Global Money Platform Launch
